variable_dictionary.Girth: Original misleading column name: this is diameter in inches,measured at4ft6in,not circumference.
variable_dictionary.Volume: Measured timber volume in cubic feet.

data.analysis_policy: For each observed tree,define a geometric cylinder with the recorded diameter and full height. Report measured timber-volume/cylinder-volume as a dimensionless descriptive form factor;equal weight per tree. One foot=12inches. A factor is a shape proxy,not a validated allometric prediction or actual trunk-cylinder claim.
